title: Design: the Categories list with its matrix and tier columns
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, so the list has a tier column of this test.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The title reads Categories; under it a label reads the number of categories and of tiers (for example "17 categories · 5 tiers").
  • At the right sit a search reading "Search categories or matrices", a three-dot button and a blue New Category button.
  • The columns read Category (with a sort arrow), Pricing Matrix (with sort arrows), then "1 Default" and each active tier as its number and name.
  • Uncategorized is the first row, bold, with a blue Default badge and an info icon; General Matrix cells carry a blue Default badge.
  • Rules show in short words, and "Uses previous tier" cells are gray, italic.
  • Fonts, spacing and alignment match picture 7.3 compared with the design picture at 100% zoom.
  • Today's QuickBooks Products And Services column (Today picture 7.1) is gone from the list.
